https://www.barrons.com/articles/amazon-will-join-the-trillion-dollar-market-cap-clubsomeday-1515611070 Amazon Will Join the Trillion Dollar Market Cap Club…Someday By Jan. 10, 2018 2:04 p.m. ET Text Size Medium Large 
The race to claim the first trillion-dollar market cap is on, with Apple ( AAPL ) and Alibaba ( BABA ) at the forefront , and today JPMorgan makes the case that Amazon.com ( AMZN ) will also join that club, even if it's not the first to do so. Illustration: Amazon 
JPMorgan analyst Doug Anmuth and his team contend that Amazon's dominance in ecommerce and its rapidly growing cloud business can make it a trillion-dollar company, though he didn't predict when that would happen. 
He has no problem, however, naming it one of his favorite tech stocks in 2018, along with Facebook ( FB ) and Priceline ( PCLN ). He cites six main drivers of Amazon's 2018 outperformance: Its numerous major growth opportunities, margin expansion, growth in Amazon Prime subscribers, Amazon Web Services' strong market share, its expanding international presences from India to Brazil, and new revenue streams from Echo to groceries. 
Anmuth reiterated his Overweight rating on Amazon and raised his price target by $10, to $1,385. Amazon is down 0.2% to $1,249.65 in recent trading. Most Popular
